card.name: Greenhouse gases entering the atmosphere
card.fires_on: Words like "into", "in" or "entering" right before "the atmosphere" after carbon dioxide or greenhouse gases, and "climate" before "crisis". It is strongest in climate and environment web text.

modes.label: Emissions into the atmosphere
modes.description: Linking word after greenhouse gas or CO2 wording, just before "the atmosphere" or "the air".
modes.example: and when carbon dioxide is released<< into>> the atmosphere, much of it is absorbed

modes.label: Climate crisis wording
modes.description: The word "climate" in activist or environmental phrases about the crisis.
modes.example: we're building a global grassroots movement to solve the<< climate>> crisis and push for policies

modes.label: Scattered other words
modes.description: Occasional mid-word or name pieces in unrelated news or policy text.
modes.example: the FDA Discovers Antib<<iotic>> Abuse on Factory Farms

card.plain: It fires on climate-pollution phrasing, especially the small word before "the atmosphere" after greenhouse gases.
